aodh.title: Aodh alarms
aodh.description: Read native Aodh alarms and capabilities in the current authenticated context. Opening this page never changes alarms or sends notifications.
aodh.capabilitiesHelp: Reported by Aodh /capabilities. This is not notifier plugin discovery or proof of notification delivery.
aodh.loadedCountsHelp: Only this verified loaded page is counted, not cloud totals. Filtering is performed by native Aodh.
aodh.countsUnknown: Current page counts are not verified. Loading, partial results and errors are not zero alarms.
aodh.emptyPage: No alarms on this verified page.
aodh.paginationHelp: Continue until Aodh returns an explicit empty page; a short page does not prove the end.
aodh.endPage: Aodh returned an explicit empty page.
aodh.selectAlarm: Select an alarm to read its native details and independent history status.
aodh.historyBound: History is bounded to the events returned by native Aodh; it is not a complete audit log.
aodh.actionPrivacy: Action URLs may contain secrets. They are displayed as plain text only, never opened or fetched by Afterglow.
aodh.noActions: No action URLs reported for this state.
aodh.authorityRequired: A ready system-administrator session is required to read native telemetry. Native scope policy remains authoritative.
settings.title: Aodh alarm settings
settings.description: Manage native alarms and state actions. The provider validates rule semantics and delivery depends on deployment configuration.
settings.rowsUnknown: No verified alarm rows are available. This is not a confirmed empty list.
settings.name: Name
settings.ruleHelp: Use the native rule object for the selected alarm type. Existing rule fields are preserved; the provider validates semantics.
settings.constraintsHelp: Native time_constraints array. Existing timezone, schedule and additional fields are preserved.
settings.actionsHelp: One URL per line. Supported schemes: http, https, trust+http, trust+https, zaqar, trust+zaqar, trust+heat and log. No direct SMTP or mailto delivery.
settings.webhookHelp: Use an HTTP(S) webhook receiver for email, chat or incident routing. Configure SMTP at that receiver, not in Aodh action URLs.
settings.trustHelp: Every trust+ action delegates Keystone trust authority. Save requires explicit confirmation; use only receivers, queues and Heat endpoints you control and trust.
settings.zaqarHelp: Zaqar requires an installed notifier, messaging endpoint and permission. Use topic/subscriber subscriptions or signed queue URLs; email delivery depends on deployed Zaqar subscription drivers.
settings.logHelp: log:// records an action in notifier logs; it does not notify a person.
settings.heatHelp: Heat signals use HTTP(S) or trust+https receivers. trust+heat:// is for Heat autohealing with loadbalancer_member_health, not a general scaling URL containing stack/policy IDs. Examples below are text, not links.
settings.catalogHelp: This list describes standard upstream methods, not discovered installed plugins. API capabilities do not prove notifier deployment, reachability or delivery. Confirm delivery independently; saving an alarm does not test it.
settings.trustConfirm: Save these trust actions? They delegate Keystone authority to the configured receivers. Confirm only if you trust every receiver.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete this native alarm? This cannot be undone.
settings.invalid: Check the JSON object/array shapes, required name and action URL schemes. Native rule semantics are validated by the provider.
settings.failed: The native request could not be completed. No automatic replay or reauthentication was attempted.
settings.uncertain: The mutation outcome is unknown. Save and delete are locked. Explicitly reread the affected alarm or alarm list before deciding what to do next; no outcome is inferred.
settings.rereadComplete: Native data reread successfully. Review the current alarm before making another change.
settings.truncated: The provider returned a bounded page. Use the next page when available.
settings.noAuthority: An authenticated system-administrator session is required. Native policy determines the permitted scope.
gnocchi.title: Gnocchi service diagnostics
gnocchi.subtitle: Read-only native metric storage, processing and archive configuration.
gnocchi.accessRequired: A verified system-administrator session is required. Native policy determines the permitted scope.
gnocchi.processingHelp: Native /status counts are a processing snapshot, not a worker heartbeat or a guarantee that workers are running or measures are current.
gnocchi.noSectionData: No diagnostic data returned. This is not a measured zero.
gnocchi.emptySection: The service returned an empty configuration or diagnostic collection.
gnocchi.resourceHelp: Browse native marker pages for the selected resource type. Counts describe the loaded page only, not cloud totals.
gnocchi.selectResource: Select a resource to inspect its named metric links.
gnocchi.noResourceMetrics: No named metric links returned for this resource.
gnocchi.metricHelp: Native metric pages are independent of the selected resource. Select a metric here or through a resource link.
gnocchi.selectMetric: Select a metric to read bounded native samples.
gnocchi.granularityHelp: Leave blank to use native archive selection; otherwise enter a finite positive number. The table always reports the actual returned native granularity.
gnocchi.invalidRange: Enter whole hours from 1 to 168 and, if supplied, a finite positive granularity.
gnocchi.measuresHelp: At most 512 samples over 168 hours. Values and units are native: no percentage conversion or service-health inference. A recorded zero is a measurement; an empty response is not zero.
gnocchi.noData: No samples returned for this metric and window. This is not a measured zero.
gnocchi.noVerifiedSamples: No verified samples are available from this response.
gnocchi.samplesTruncated: The bounded sample response is truncated; this is not the complete requested history.
gnocchi.pendingMeasures: Read measures to apply the selected window, aggregation and granularity.
gnocchi.emptyPage: No records on this native page.
gnocchi.unverifiedPage: No verified records returned; this is not a confirmed empty inventory.
gnocchi.pagingHelp: Next follows the native marker, even for a short page. An explicit empty page ends browsing.
gnocchi.pageTruncated: This page is bounded or incomplete. Follow the native marker when available.
